cards.text: John, the servant who was sent this revelation of Jesus Christ (Revelation 1:1), is on the island of Patmos (Revelation 1:9), and he's just written down the messages to the seven churches (Revelation 2-3). Now he looks and sees a door standing open in heaven. The voice he heard before, the one like a trumpet, calls out, “Come up here,” and promises to show him something.

cards.question: The trumpet-like voice calls John up through the open door in heaven. What does it promise to show him?

answers.text: What must happen after these things
Where the garden of Eden stood

cards.text: At once John is in the Spirit, and he sees a throne standing in heaven with someone seated on it. No waiting room, no take-a-number ticket, no hold music, friend, just straight to the THRONE.

The One seated there looks like jasper and carnelian, and a rainbow that gleams like an emerald circles the throne. My favorite color is the rainbow, friend, because I could never pick just one, so you KNOW I'm leaning in on this.
Twenty-four other thrones surround the throne, and on them sit twenty-four elders dressed in white, with golden crowns on their heads. And friend, I thought my tall chef's hat was fancy.

cards.question: Flashes of lightning come from the throne John is seeing. What else comes from it?

cards.text: Friend, my oven timer dings and I hop three feet in the air, gold base and all, so that THUNDER would have me hiding under a mixing bowl. Before the throne burn seven torches of fire, and John says these are the seven spirits of God.

cards.question: Before the throne John sees something like a sea of ___, as clear as crystal.

cards.text: In the center, around the throne, are four living creatures covered with eyes in front and back. Friend, I've got two eyes and I STILL can't find my rolling pin.

The first living creature is like a lion, the second like a calf, the third has a face like a man, and the fourth is like an eagle in flight. Each one has six wings and is covered with eyes all around and within.

cards.question: Day and night the four living creatures never stop saying: “Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!” Their words speak of Him only as He was long ago.
Whenever the living creatures give glory, honor and thanks to the One seated on the throne, the twenty-four elders fall down before Him and worship.
As the twenty-four elders fall down and worship, what do they do with their golden crowns?

answers.text: Hand them to the living creatures

cards.question: Then the elders tell the Lord God He is worthy to receive glory and honor and power, because He ___ all things.

cards.text: Then John sees a scroll in the right hand of the One seated on the throne. It has writing on both sides and seven seals on it, and friend, I can't open ONE cookie box without a fight.

cards.question: A mighty angel calls out in a loud voice, “Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?” Who in heaven or on earth or under the earth is able to do it?
With no one found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it, John begins to weep bitterly.

cards.text: Friend, I spent years in the back of a junk drawer waiting for somebody to open it, so I get it. But one of the elders says to John, “Do not weep!” and tells him someone has triumphed to open the scroll and its seven seals.

cards.question: The elder calls the One who has triumphed the Root of David, Israel's king, and the Lion of the tribe of ___.
After hearing the elder, John looks toward the throne. What does he see standing in the center of it?

answers.text: A lion with a golden crown

cards.text: Let that sit a second, friend: the elder says Lion, John looks, and there stands a Lamb who appeared to have been slain. This Lamb is Jesus, the Lamb of God (John 1:29).

cards.question: The Lamb has seven horns and seven eyes. John says they represent the seven ___ of God sent out into all the earth.

cards.text: Now the Lamb makes His move and comes to the One seated on the throne.

cards.question: The Lamb waits for the mighty angel to hand Him the scroll.

cards.text: When He takes the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fall down before the Lamb. Each one has a harp, and they're holding golden bowls full of incense.

cards.question: The living creatures and the elders hold golden bowls full of incense, which John says are the ___ of the saints.
The four living creatures and the twenty-four elders sing a new song to the Lamb. Why do they say He is worthy to take the scroll and open its seals?

answers.text: He was slain and purchased people for God
He is the oldest one in all of heaven
The mighty angel chose Him to open it

cards.question: By His blood the Lamb purchased people for God. Where are those people from?

answers.text: Every tribe and tongue and nation

cards.text: The song goes on: He has made them a kingdom and priests to serve God, and they will reign upon the earth.

Then John hears the voices of many angels encircling the throne, along with the living creatures and the elders, and their number is myriads of myriads and thousands of thousands. In a loud voice they say: “Worthy is the Lamb who was slain, to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing!”

cards.question: After the angels' loud praise, only the creatures in heaven join in praising Him who sits on the throne and the Lamb.

cards.text: Every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea says: “To Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and power forever and ever!”
The four living creatures say, “Amen,” and the elders fall down and worship. Hold that thought and keep your apron on, friend, because this story is just getting started.
